agri_coltivio.subheading: Together for free and independent agriculture
agri_coltivio.community_text: Become part of a community that stands for open and fair agriculture.
agri_coltivio.membership_intro_pre: Agri Coltivio, which operates the Coltivio platform, is a
agri_coltivio.membership_intro_mid:
.

No investor expecting a return, and no one making a business out of your data.
agri_coltivio.membership_intro_bold_2: A solution that truly belongs to farmers.
agri_coltivio.member_benefit_1: A say in how the platform develops
agri_coltivio.member_benefit_2: Voting rights at the general assembly
agri_coltivio.section_2: Coltivio is open source — which means not only farmers benefit, but developers can actively contribute to its growth. The app evolves continuously, independently, and close to real farming needs.
agri_coltivio.section_3_bold: Data security is a top priority.
agri_coltivio.section_3: All data is stored exclusively on servers within the EU and subject to strict GDPR regulations. Because the source code is publicly visible, Coltivio stays transparent and verifiable — anyone can see exactly how it works.
agri_coltivio.donate_link_alt: Or support us with a donation.
agri_coltivio.donate_sub: Every contribution counts and helps us build an independent alternative that puts the interests of farmers first.
agri_coltivio.donate_thank_you_body_2: You will receive an email with a donation confirmation shortly.

archive.meadow_restore_warning: The meadow will show up again on the map and when adding grazing periods. If new meadows were added on this area since it was archived, they may overlap with it.
archive.meadow_active_schedules: The meadow still has ongoing or planned grazing periods ({{herds}}). End or remove these grazing periods before archiving the meadow.

parasite_checks.famacha_scores_info: 1 = red (healthy) to 5 = white (severely anaemic). Tap again to clear.
parasite_checks.duplicate_parasite_type: Each parasite may only appear once per sample
parasite_checks.pooled_info: One sample for all {{count}} animals of the check.
parasite_checks.individual_info: Tap an animal to record its result. Not every animal needs a result.
parasite_checks.recheck_locked_info: Method and animals are taken from the base check. Animals that died are left out.
parasite_checks.delete_check_with_rechecks_confirm: Delete this check and its {{count}} re-checks?
parasite_checks.name: Name
parasite_checks.mixed_animal_types: A check can only contain animals of one animal type.
parasite_checks.chart_counts_info: Numbers in the charts = number of animals checked
parasite_checks.all_base_animals_dead: All animals of the base check have died or no longer exist.

breeding.reminders_description: Push reminders before expected births. Applies to your account on all devices; if notifications are blocked on a device, the reminders are turned off.
breeding.gestation_description: Applies to the whole farm. An empty field resets to the default.
breeding.only_owner_can_edit: Only the farm management can change the gestation length.
breeding.permission_denied: Notifications are turned off in the system settings. Allow them there to get reminders before births.
